description: Search open job postings by title or skill words, with optional filters: location (every word must be a whole word of the posting's place, such as Toronto or Sweden), remote (true for remote only, false to leave remote out), posted_within_days and company. With company (an ats:slug token such as greenhouse:airbnb, a Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board address, or a name tried on all three) it reads that company's public job board; without it, the open feeds: JobTech (Sweden, CC0), Remote OK and Canada Job Bank (OGL-Canada). Each job row has title, company, locations, remote, posted_at, the apply link and its source; data_job_details gives a board posting's full text. Costs 1 credit for a company board, else 1 per feed read (3). Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

company.description: Optional: one company's board, as greenhouse:airbnb, lever:spotify, ashby:notion, a board address or a company name.

location.description: Optional place words, such as Toronto, Stockholm or Canada.

posted_within_days.description: Optional: only postings first published this many days back or less.

q.description: Job title or skill words, such as "data engineer"; every word must appear in the title, company or occupation (feeds also match the ad text).

remote.description: Optional: true for remote jobs only, false to leave remote jobs out.

name: data_search_jobs
title: Search job postings
